title: Blue Monkey: wheat ale in all its splendor
description: We have brewed a new batch of our main wheat hit, bringing the recipe to absolute perfection. And we are in a hurry to share it with you!

blocks.html:
Blue Monkey Wheat Ale is a light, pure wheat ale, a wonderful example of style, which has everything you need:
The shade of the drink is light straw, shimmering.The aroma is expressive, harmonious, with notes of wheat, bread, fresh hay, citrus fruits, honey, vanilla.The taste is rich, with a pleasant sourness and a barely noticeable hop bitterness, wheat, fruity, slightly spicy, with clove and banana shades.The aftertaste is soft, delicate, and sweet.
The drink is based on three types of malt: Pilsner Malt — traditional, slightly sweet; Wheat Malt, which is made from selected spring wheat and refined oat Malt. Spicy coriander and citrus peel give the beer a refined, elegant, refreshing spring bouquet.

Wheat ale is best combined with fish dishes, as well as seafood.
